text:
Ana: Quick sync — we need to triage three things before sprint planning: launch criteria for the batching feature (customer ask), RICE scoring for Q3 candidates, and the SLO/toil items Jamie flagged.
Mike: +1. can we do this in-thread? tight on time. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sophia: I put a rough RICE table in the doc but TL;DR: batching Reach=4 Impact=3 Confidence=60 Effort=5 -> score ~1.44. customer needs lower cost per-token.
Jamie (oncall): FYI, last 7d error-budget burn = 18%, P99 tail latency up ~20% after last deploy, and oncall did 6 manual interventions (toil).
Liz (product): Customers want predictable latency and a canary gating plan before we call this GA. launch checklist needs acceptance criteria + rollback plan.
Ana: Proposed: 1) Do a 1-day spike to tighten canary gating metrics + rollback playbook. 2) Defer low-confidence customer asks to backlog with lower RICE. 3) Carve a 2-week quota for SLO remediation sprint if error budget >15%. Agree?
Mike: Is the 15% threshold from SRE policy or ad-hoc?
Jamie (oncall): It's what we've been using in emergencies. I can formalize it into a short runbook. Also note: most toil came from manual KV-cache flushes — could be automated in ~8h.
Sophia: If we automate KV cache flush, effort=2, impact on toil=4, confidence=80 -> RICE-ish says do it next sprint. That will also reduce tail latency spikes.
Liz (product): Spike + automation sounds good. We still need a product acceptance criterion: P95 < 120ms on read-heavy workloads and zero customer-facing error spikes during canary.
Ana: Make those acceptance criteria. Ownership: Sophia -> spike & automation estimate, Jamie -> runbook + instrumentation, Mike -> update RICE doc with numbers, Liz -> sign off product criteria. Everyone ok?
Mike: Ok. I'll update the doc. Can we add a temporary fallback model route during canary to reduce customer impact? simple routing policy change.
Jamie (oncall): We can do fallback routing. Add an automated rollback trigger: if error-budget burn >5% in 30m window -> rollback.
Sophia: For the spike I'll run a short perf harness against staging with these scenarios: cold KV miss, long seq (4096), and noisy concurrency. I'll post logs here.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2036543305 started for model-batching-experiment.
Liz (product): Great — schedule a 30m demo after spike completes so we can validate acceptance criteria.
Ana: Thanks. Quick summary tasks inline: Sophia: spike + automation estimate; Jamie: runbook + rollback trigger; Mike: RICE update + routing plan; Liz: acceptance signoff. Target: have spike results in <48h.
Mike: :thumbsup: If spike looks good, we'll schedule a small canary to 5% traffic and monitor the error budget dashboard.
Jamie (oncall): I'll pin an incident channel and add a short checklist for oncall to follow during canary.
Ana: Perfect. If anything unexpected pops up, drop in #incidents and ping @Jamie. Closing sync — thanks all.
